snippet.title: Clans of Four Color Official Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Hi behnia here, This is the reveal trailer for our third-person chess-action indie game. The game isn’t out yet, but it’s coming soon. If you enjoy this kind of content, consider subscribing. Thank you for your support. We’re open to all kinds of creative ideas and feedback.

Here is the link for the game on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4247670/Clans_of_Four_Color_Impossible_Promise/

Music in the video: Alexander Nakarada, Free-Stock-Music.com, licensed under CC BY 4.0.
